integrity: Full constructive proof and standalone exhaustive small-instance verifier; finite checks are not general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct approved goods per agent; every good approved; efficient goods allocations; conclusions do not cover efficiency-free allocation. The motivating 2026 full preprint was inaccessible and publication priority uncertain.
title: A cycle-rank obstruction to efficient envy-and-equitability fairness with two approved goods per agent
